title: Infrastructure-based Monocular 3D Vehicle Localization Framework with Experimental Validation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a one-stage learning framework that maps monocular roadside-camera images directly to vehicle states in a ground-fixed coordinate frame. Unlike conventional approaches that first detect vehicles in the image plane and subsequently apply geometric post-processing, the proposed method leverages features from a pretrained object detector to jointly estimate each vehicle's ground-plane position, dimensions, and yaw angle. The framework therefore uses visual features not only for vehicle detection but also for direct spatial and orientation estimation. To support model training and evaluation, we develop a data-collection and label-generation pipeline based on synchronized video from a roadside camera and an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). translated_title: 基于基础设施的单目三维车辆定位框架及实验验证
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种单阶段学习框架，将路边单目相机图像直接映射到地面固定坐标系中的车辆状态。与先在图像平面中检测车辆、随后进行几何后处理的传统方法不同，所提出的方法利用预训练目标检测器提取的特征，联合估计每辆车的地面平面位置、尺寸和偏航角。因此，该框架不仅将视觉特征用于车辆检测，还将其用于直接的空间位置和朝向估计。为支持模型训练和评估，我们开发了一个基于路边相机与无人机（UAV）同步视频的数据采集和标签生成流水线。作为临时性的俯视感知平台，无人机提供车辆轨迹、尺寸和朝向信息，这些信息被转换到地面固定坐标系中。
tldr: 本文提出一种单阶段学习框架，直接从路边单目相机图像联合估计车辆在地面固定坐标系中的位置、尺寸和偏航角，并利用路边相机与无人机同步视频构建数据采集与标注流水线，完成了实验验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a one-stage learning framework that directly estimates vehicle ground-plane position, dimensions, and yaw angle from monocular roadside camera images, supported by a synchronized roadside camera-UAV data pipeline for experimental validation.
